name: Love Live! ~After School Idols~
source: Taking place shortly after the first game, Uranohoshi Girls' High School is relaunched with new students and teachers, who seem to focus more on having fun than taking the school seriously. There's a big party to celebrate the relaunch of the school at the end of the first week of classes and everyone's looking for someone special to bring as their date.
translation: 在第一场比赛后不久，浦之星女子高中重新启动，迎来了新学生和老师，他们似乎更注重娱乐而不是认真对待学校。在课程第一周结束时，有一个盛大的聚会来庆祝学校重新开学，每个人都在寻找一个特别的人作为他们的约会对象。
